citations.quote: Born in Las Vegas, Hafen received his bachelor's degree in business management from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas.
After graduation, Gregory went to work for his family business, Pahrump Utility Company Inc., and climbed his way to general manager.
Hafen is the general manager of the Pahrump Utility Company, a water utility that was founded by his grandfather, father and aunt in 1995.
Following his time in college, Hafen II began his career in his family’s Pahrump Utility Company, working his way up to the position he currently holds with that company, general manager.

citations.quote: Prior to his appointment to the Assembly, he was chairman of the Pahrump Regional Planning Commission and the Pahrump Capital Improvement Advisory Committee.

He previously chaired the Pahrump Regional Planning Commission, Pahrump Capital Improvement Advisory Committee, chaired the Pahrump Ground Water Management Plan Advisory Committee and has participated in developing numerous Nye County Ordinances and Nye County comprehensive plans.
